checks.evaluator: Codex native independent visual artifact reviewer plus direct image inspection

observations.evidence_class: native-agent visual judgment over exact sealed digital projections, source, and product render

indexed_state_assessment.owl: ambiguous cat, bear, or pawn-like mass

limitations: No human play, finite phone emitter, normal-room contrast, physical use, or recognition behavior was observed.
observations.summary: Rabbit is unmistakable, but fox and owl remain ambiguous without labels; alignment covers only owl, and the reset and beam-direction cues are not discoverable in the setup render.
observations.transition_interpretation: eclipse wipe between indexed animals; no continuous-recognition claim

checks.evaluator: Codex native independent mechanical reviewer plus deterministic fit and motion replay

observations.evidence_class: deterministic digital geometry replay plus independent adversarial source and motion audit
limitations: No physical snap, detent, retention, tipping, pinch, load, strength, or cycle test was performed.
observations.summary: Nominal fit and declared motion checks pass, but the reel sweep omits the functional front detent, hook insertion is not demonstrated, and the deployed stand endpoint conflicts with the authored brief.

checks.evaluator: Codex native independent printability reviewer plus deterministic exact-STL replay

observations.evidence_class: deterministic digital mesh, bed-fit, standard wall, and explicit rear fine-wall evidence
limitations: No slicer, support decision, successful print, warping, layer adhesion, physical fit, strength, or cycle test was performed.
observations.summary: All four exact STL meshes pass connectivity, topology, winding, volume, bed fit, and standard 0.8 mm wall checks; the repaired rear shell also passes the explicit fine replay with zero below-minimum samples.

feedback.area: indexed creature recognition, alignment coverage, and setup discovery
feedback.change: Sharpen the fox snout and ear language; rebuild the owl with unmistakable printable beak/eye openings or stronger exterior beak, wing, feet, and perch separation; render all three indexed states at centered and plus-or-minus two-degree yaw/pitch; add a conspicuous fixed rabbit-home pointer plus phone/beam arrow and a setup-side render.
feedback.finding: The exact rabbit is unmistakable, but the fox can read as a squirrel/rabbit hybrid and the owl remains a solid cat/bear/pawn-like mass without surviving beak, eyes, wings, feet, or perch cues. Alignment evidence tests only owl, and neither a fixed rabbit-home pointer nor phone/beam-direction cue is legible in a setup view.

feedback.area: functional detent cycle, shell insertion, and stand endpoint
feedback.change: Use a rounded or ramped detent nose and pockets and verify a complete two-way engaged cycle. Replace each symmetric barb with a one-direction cantilever latch or other demonstrable receiver path and test closure separately from pullout. Correct the stand angle and footprint to the authored endpoint and rerun finer endpoint and full-arc sweeps.
feedback.finding: The declared reel sweep omits the front-shell detent and collides immediately when that obstacle is included; flat vertical detent geometry has no demonstrated cam path. Symmetric four-sided barbs are tested only after closure, not through their smaller receivers. The 108-degree stand pose and 94.067 mm assembly depth conflict with the authored 112-degree, about-82 mm endpoint.
